_comment: Paper Radar query config. Hand-curated per paper -- do NOT auto-generate these from paper titles. Naive keyword extraction fails badly here: 'von neumann probe' on Crossref returns papers about von Neumann ALGEBRAS. Each query is a tight phrase chosen to be precise over recall. Tune freely; the search script reads this file every run.

_schema.key: short id, also used in seen.json
_schema.file: path to the paper, relative to repo root
_schema.title: short title for the digest
_schema.thesis: one line, given to the screening agent as the relevance test
_schema.arxiv: list of arXiv API search phrases (quoted phrases are AND-ed loosely by arXiv)
_schema.crossref: list of Crossref bibliographic queries -- keep these VERY specific, Crossref is the noisiest source
_schema.exclude: substrings that, if present in a title, drop the hit outright (precision guardrails)

_exclude_note: These are homonym guardrails, each one added after it actually polluted a live run. 'Fermi' is a physics surname before it is a paradox; 'probe' is a lab reagent before it is a spacecraft; 'Neumann' is an operator before it is a self-replicator. Add to this list rather than narrowing the queries -- broad query + sharp exclude preserves recall.

papers.title: Vehicle -- Growth, Not Speed
papers.thesis: A slow (~450 km/s) self-replicating interstellar probe that brakes to a stop via magnetic sail, powered by a ~4 kW fission reactor, and replicates at its destination. Relevant work: slow interstellar mission architectures, magsail/ISM braking, nuclear-electric propulsion at kW scale, self-replicating spacecraft design.

papers.title: Payload -- The Mind
papers.thesis: Onboard cognition and memory for a probe operating unsupervised for millennia: an immutable value core, an interpretive layer, and a freely self-modifying cognitive layer. Relevant work: long-duration autonomous agents, value stability under self-modification, machine memory architectures, spacecraft autonomy.
openalex: representational drift continual learning stability plasticity
constitution following instruction hierarchy language model
crossref: autonomous spacecraft cognition deep space mission

papers.title: Bootstrapping -- From Seed to Factory
papers.thesis: Industrial closure: how a seed payload bootstraps a full manufacturing base from local material (the L1-L5 closure ladder, the ~3% vitamin fraction). Relevant work: self-replicating factories, ISRU, closure of manufacturing chains, lunar/asteroid industrial bootstrapping.
openalex: in-situ resource utilization regolith processing manufacturing closure
lunar regolith additive manufacturing sintering construction
crossref: in-situ resource utilization autonomous manufacturing closure

papers.title: Analytical engineering -- Engineering Closure
papers.thesis: First-order four-budget model (mass, energy, material, capability) for a self-replicating seed; the finding that material and energy margins never bind, capability does. Relevant work: spacecraft mass/energy budgeting methods, closure metrics, order-of-magnitude feasibility models.
openalex: spacecraft mass energy budget model feasibility

papers.title: Computational engineering -- Engineering Closure, Computed
papers.thesis: Code-backed R_eff = sum(p_i * V_i) across a 127-star catalogue; the knife-edge result that expansion needs >=3 offspring or per-leg reliability >=0.9. Relevant work: simulations of interstellar colonization, replication/extinction thresholds, branching-process models of settlement.

papers.title: DNA mission-ledger
papers.thesis: DNA as the probe's archival memory substrate plus a tamper-evident integrity ledger. Relevant work: DNA data storage density/longevity/error correction, archival storage over geological time, hash-chained integrity ledgers.
openalex: DNA data storage error correction longevity
hash chain integrity ledger tamper evident
crossref: DNA data storage archival error correction

papers.title: Governance -- Contact, Contamination, Noninterference
papers.thesis: The E0-E7 contact ladder; planetary protection and noninterference for an unsupervised autonomous probe; capability-yes/release-no on biology. Relevant work: planetary protection policy, SETI/METI post-detection protocols, noninterference ethics, space law for autonomous systems.

papers.title: Governed amendment -- Amending the Unamendable
papers.thesis: Whether an immutable value core can ever be legitimately amended by the lineage that inherits it -- the series' deepest open problem, bracketed not solved. Relevant work: corrigibility, goal stability, constitutional amendment theory, AI value drift, mechanisms for legitimate rule change without central authority.
openalex: value drift autonomous agents over time

papers.title: Fermi -- Slow Fire, Silent Galaxy
papers.thesis: Reframes the Fermi paradox via R_eff x D x G: slow, quiet, non-signalling expansion is consistent with an apparently empty galaxy. Relevant work: Fermi paradox resolutions, galactic colonization timescales, technosignature non-detection, Great Filter arguments.
openalex: quiet expansion undetected galactic colonization AI
crossref: Fermi paradox von Neumann probe galactic colonization

papers.title: Knowledge growth -- The Growing Archive
papers.thesis: K = observational + operational knowledge; K(t) = G(t) - L(t); cruise as an active knowledge-growth phase; probe-probe knowledge synthesis. Relevant work: autonomous scientific discovery, knowledge accumulation metrics, information loss/bit-rot over long timescales, machine-driven hypothesis generation.

papers.title: Lineage network -- Signal and Silence
papers.thesis: A delay-tolerant interstellar network: DTN bundle protocol, tree-to-mesh topology over ~10^5 yr, geographic and spray-and-wait routing, heartbeat failure detection at 500-5,000 yr silence thresholds. Relevant work: DTN/bundle protocol, extreme-delay networking, opportunistic routing, failure detection in partitioned networks.
openalex: delay tolerant networking bundle protocol deep space
crossref: delay tolerant networking deep space bundle protocol

papers.title: Subsystem budget
papers.thesis: Second-level decomposition of the ~3,700 kg seed: per-subsystem mass, cruise power of 50-150 W (4 kW is the reactor rating and the manufacturing-phase load, never the cruise draw), two-mode thermal (11 m^2 cruise radiators vs hundreds-thousands m^2 built in situ). Central result: mass coupling runs through the 54% manufacturing fraction; cognition is mass-free at ~5%. Relevant work: space nuclear reactors, radiator/thermal mass scaling, spacecraft subsystem mass models.
openalex: space nuclear reactor kilopower fission surface power
crossref: space fission reactor electric power spacecraft

papers.title: Fleet routing -- Three Dispatches
papers.thesis: Coverage and dispatch over the 127-star catalogue: 65% reachable at 10 ly hops, 93% at 20 ly; 5-9 articulation points; the three-dispatch rule (P_cover 0.90-0.95); coverage-first beats nearest-first by 62,000 yr. Relevant work: network reachability/percolation on stellar graphs, dispatch and coverage optimization, articulation points and robustness, redundant-attempt reliability.
arxiv: "random geometric graph" AND connectivity AND robustness
openalex: percolation threshold random geometric graph connectivity
k-connectivity articulation point spatial network robustness

papers.title: Ethics of Creating the Lineage
papers.thesis: Whether it is justified to launch an unsupervised self-replicating lineage that outlives its creators: consent (Rawls), non-identity (Parfit), commons (Hardin), value-imposition, moral status/legal personhood, dual-use risk, existential-risk justification. Relevant work: space ethics, non-identity problem, moral status of artificial agents, long-termism, dual-use/runaway replication risk.
openalex: space colonization ethics obligations planetary protection
moral status artificial agents machine personhood
non-identity problem future generations population ethics

papers.title: Speciation or Schism
papers.thesis: Whether long-run divergence between settled branches is failure or success: taxonomy of divergence sources, D_critical boundary, drift-clock model, ring-species argument, adaptive radiation raising total R_eff and K. Relevant work: speciation theory, cultural/design drift in artificial populations, ring species, adaptive radiation, horizontal transfer, divergence in evolving machine populations.
openalex: ring species divergence gene flow isolation
barcode gap interspecific intraspecific divergence threshold
speciation continuum divergence with gene flow

papers.title: Security -- Security Without Victory
papers.thesis: Probe-vs-probe security for a deep-time lineage: defenses built against entropy fail against adaptive adversaries; security relocates from node to lineage (bounding blast radius, not preventing compromise); targeted articulation-point removal gives 3-4x leverage; counselor posture, suppressed state, symmetry argument, autoimmunity risk. Relevant work: targeted attacks on network robustness, adversarial multi-agent systems, containment architectures, acceptance-rule mimicry, quarantine/autoimmunity trade-offs.
arxiv: "articulation point" AND graph AND (attack OR robustness)
openalex: articulation points targeted attack spatial networks
quarantine autoimmunity false positive distributed agents
network dismantling spatial geometric lattice robustness
crossref: targeted attack articulation point spatial network robustness
papers._retune_note: 2026-08-25: first post-retune sweep returned 17 hits, all applied cybersecurity/security-studies noise (digest 08-25). Every query now carries a graph-structural or probe/replication token, mirroring the ethics fix; the network-robustness leg is scoped to spatial/geometric graphs, which is the class whose results transfer (the paper itself demonstrates degree/spectral heuristics do not).
